evals.prompt: Translate all the markdown files under docs/en into Simplified Chinese and save them under docs/chn, keeping the same folder structure.
evals.expected_output: docs/chn mirrors docs/en exactly (including nested subfolders like api/). Prose, headings, tables, and link text are translated to natural Simplified Chinese. Frontmatter, code blocks, inline code, URLs, and technical terms (ARXML, AUTOSAR, pip commands) are preserved verbatim.

evals.prompt: 帮我把这个目录下 en 文件夹里的所有 markdown 文档翻译成简体中文，放到 chn 文件夹里
evals.expected_output: Same behavior via a casual Chinese-language prompt: all *.md files under en/ translated into Simplified Chinese and written to chn/ with mirrored structure, preserving code/frontmatter/URLs.

evals.prompt: Translate the markdown files in en/ into Simplified Chinese under chn/.
evals.expected_output: chn/guide.md already exists (stale translation). The agent must NOT silently overwrite it — either asks how to proceed, or (headless) skips it, translates the missing file, and reports the conflict in the summary.

evals.prompt: Please translate the markdown files under content/en into Japanese, saving them to content/ja.
evals.expected_output: Tests parameter override: output lands in content/ja (not chn) and is in natural Japanese, structure mirrored, same preservation rules for code/frontmatter/URLs.

evals.prompt: Translate everything in docs/en into Simplified Chinese under docs/chn. These chapters came out of docling (PDF to markdown), so they contain inline base64 images.
evals.expected_output: Files with data:image URIs go through the extract→translate→restore pipeline: the final chn file contains every original data-URI string byte-for-byte at the correct position, no IMG_PLACEHOLDER tokens remain, prose/headings are natural Simplified Chinese, and docling marker headings like ## NOTE stay untranslated while their body is translated.

evals.prompt: Translate docs/en/Chapter_02_Introduction.md into Simplified Chinese under docs/chn, keeping the docling table pagination structure.
evals.expected_output: Structural completeness: heading count/numbering identical to source; every table block present with the same row count (incl. continued-table blocks split at the same page-break points); every list item present; every figure/table caption number present; all inline images byte-identical (md_images.py verify + verify_structure.py both PASS).

evals.prompt: Translate docs/en into Simplified Chinese under docs/chn, as fast as you can — the manual has a large reference chapter. Use parallelism.
evals.expected_output: All files translated and mirrored; image verify + structure verify PASS on every file (incl. the large Chapter_03_Reference.md). The run does NOT translate segment after segment in one conversation: the large chapter is split at heading boundaries (md_split.py split) with segments translated by parallel subagents then joined, and small files are distributed across parallel workers with a shared terminology glossary. Timing recorded in timing.json shows the wall-clock time; the with-skill run must be substantially faster than the without-skill sequential baseline.
